comment: A "Sync fills to phrase" parameter is declared with no widget (it has no position in the census) and is set from the menu's Fills item instead. Pattern sets come from three shipped banks plus any files in the plugin's own patterns folder under Rack's user directory, and drum-patterns.com text exports are read directly (fill.cpp:403). Favourites are kept plugin-wide in a file beside that folder rather than in the patch (fill.cpp:543), so a set starred in one project is starred in the next.
